raw: {"analysis": "JFW provides a more rigorous gate structure with explicit cost caps and a nuanced flake protocol (run twice, verify logs) rather than CMF's blunt 'ignore' approach, which could mask real failures. JFW also includes an independent verification lane and concrete rollback metrics (latency >30s, duplicate rate >0.1%), making it more actionable with fewer follow-ups. CMF is solid but less detailed on cost control and flake handling, and its rollback via DNS re-routing is more complex than JFW's feature-flag toggle.", "verdict": "JFW"}
